request: 我需要直接接入aide，纯离线使用，不需要额外的添加设置
acceptance: Office editor engine is bundled in the Aide runtime for Linux arm64/amd64; no runtime download, external Office service, address entry or Office settings required.
Fresh Aide with no Office settings opens DOCX/XLSX/PPTX in the existing viewer; preview/edit/save survive a runtime with no external network.
Engine is lazy-started, health-checked, restarted after failure and stopped with Aide; backend/callback listen on random loopback ports and are never published.
Browser resources and WebSockets use the existing Aide origin through a capability-protected proxy; only editor endpoints are exposed, never admin/conversion or full Aide credentials.
Existing document tokens, read-only/workspace/lock/version guards and inactive-preview AI read/edit behavior remain verified.
Package includes pinned engine provenance/licenses and fails build on missing/corrupt engine; prior separately deployed service setup is replaced with the built-in default.
No externally exposed plugin service: public /wopi/ is 404; engine/proxy access without an Aide-issued document-session capability is refused; no admin or conversion service exposed.
scope: Dockerfile, Dockerfile.local and runtime build-input hashing
docker/office-engine/ pinned source manifest and legal notices
docs/prd, docs/plugins/office.md, docs/reviews and task record
compose.yaml, docker/compose.offline.yaml shared Office/Go memory budget
internal/server/office_document.go removal of unused HTTP wrappers

requirements.summary: User explicitly requests directly integrated, fully offline Office use with no additional settings. Implement in an isolated worktree; preserve existing local data/runtime.

design.summary: Bundle the unmodified upstream CODE AppImage in the existing Aide Linux runtime. Aide lazily manages a loopback child and private WOPI callback; same-origin authenticated proxy and no plugin service fields.

implementation.summary: Built-in pinned engine, managed random loopback child/callback, document-session proxy, no Office settings, and no general document read/edit HTTP routes. AI uses the internal native dispatcher.

verification.summary: Actual isolated offline DOCX/XLSX/PPTX edit/save/readback and engine crash recovery passed. Final source/full verification and final artifact acceptance pending.

documentation.summary: PRD, host/plugin documentation and provenance reflect built-in offline and Aide-only boundaries; distinguishes actual checks from pending release.

release.summary: Previous explicit push/market authorization applies to this Office refinement. Complete final checks before host/Office 1.3.0/market updates; no daily-runtime deployment or Aide application version/tag/Release.
